verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS identity platform, but the pack documents no first-party export of org data in open formats. The SCIM material covers outbound user provisioning to other apps, which is a different capability, and the Admin API/MCP server are only building blocks a developer could use to assemble an export. Off-topic community security sentiment was ignored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
